crossRefs.note: Now therefore please forgive my sin again, and pray to Yahweh your God, that he may also take away from me this death.”

translations.web: Now therefore, please pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship Yahweh.”
translations.bsb: Now therefore, please forgive my sin and return with me so I can worship the LORD.”
translations.kjv: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.
translations.asv: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship Jehovah.
